name: receiving-desk
title: Receiving desk
subtitle: Demo records are fictional. Review exceptions before release.

sections.title: Condition round
sections.sql: select code,site,condition,units,expected_units,seal_check,open_issues from v_condition order by code

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by shipment,kind

sections.title: Issues due
sections.sql: select code,shipment,owner,due_on,kind,severity from v_issue_queue where status='open' order by due_on

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select shipment,rule,finding,basis from v_compliance order by shipment,rule
